Shared father is explicit/inferred; full shared parentage is not proved by the cited sentences. Not used as identity proof.
The treatise alternates Yongkang/next-year/Taian timing or telescopes the Jia purge and usurpation. Preserve contradictory source/metadata; do not date-normalize or split identity to hide it.
Attestations invoke a Ming reign table for Jin episodes. Excluded from identity proof; no new year conversions made.

Knowing Lun includes the translated verb from 允知, not a valid personal name. Chinese 相國倫 and continuous chancellor narrative determine the referent; no edits made.
Liang 肜 is rendered Xiong in one annal sentence; Pei 頠 is rendered Yi; 允母弟 is rendered younger brother of Yun’s mother instead of his maternal younger brother. Separate editorial QA only.
Yongchang versus Yongan palace renaming differs in the sealed accounts. Identity uses deposition/restoration sequence, not silent harmonization.
